name: Pedro Alfarrobeira
bio:
Pedro Alfarrobeira is a highly skilled tattoo artist, known for his expertise in the unique and dynamic styles of trashpolka and illustrative tattoos. Operating out of Alfa 13 Tattoo—a private studio—he has a reputation for maintaining a pristine and hygienic environment, ensuring that every client's experience is not only visually satisfying but clean and safe as well. With the ability to cater to both local clients and guests in Portugal, Luxembourg, and Switzerland, Pedro's professionalism is admired by tattoo enthusiasts across Europe.
